_source_privacy.note: Privacy-redacted metadata projection. Host/user/path strings are portable placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Numeric fixtures, recorded file hashes and historical measurement claims are unchanged.

img_cap.name: img_cap
img_cap.why: whole-model oracle prompt image, 6000x4000 resized to the 8000-token cap, 31,828 patches

photo_like.name: photo_like
photo_like.why: synthetic landscape: smooth regions, edges, texture

rgba_soft.name: rgba_soft
rgba_soft.why: RGBA, smooth alpha ramp and a transparent disc (composited on white by the fork)

rgba_ramp.name: rgba_ramp
rgba_ramp.why: RGBA 64x48: transparency on a small image that is upscaled to the 16-token minimum

odd_331x257.name: odd_331x257
odd_331x257.why: odd size, padded canvas on the right and bottom, hard stripes and noise

exact_280x196.name: exact_280x196
exact_280x196.why: a size on the 28-pixel grid: no padding, no resize

tall_40x2500.name: tall_40x2500
tall_40x2500.why: tall and thin: 1 patch column band, a long image

thin_5x700.name: thin_5x700
thin_5x700.why: 5 pixels wide: the smallest canvas width

tiny_3x5.name: tiny_3x5
tiny_3x5.why: 3x5 pixels, upscaled to the minimum canvas

px_1x1.name: px_1x1
px_1x1.why: a single pixel (the minimum canvas, 16 tokens)

noise_257x255.name: noise_257x255
noise_257x255.why: hash noise at an odd size

notes: Every tensor is dumped as the fork holds it: f32 for the residual stream and the features, f16 for fp16 activations.
A candidate is judged by tolerance (crates/model/tests/glm_vision.rs), never by hash: a SHA-256 match proves a bit-identical regeneration only.
